source_equivalence: Fixed design asserts N500,J60 and exactly first140MZ followed by360DZ rho values before generating centered code. The actual prepared data hash matches the previous noncentered dataset byte-for-byte; there is no response regeneration change.

Priors are inserted from the hash-pinned baseline env$prior: ta,tc~Gamma(1,1), beta0~Normal(0,variance1), beta1 and mu~Normal(0,variance10). va=1/ta,vc=1/tc,ve=exp(beta0) retain interpretation. No flat variance or changed residual prior has been introduced.

Each c[i] is Normal(0,precision tc). For MZ, a[i,1] is Normal(0,precision ta), and a[i,2] is the deterministic same value. For DZ, a[i,1] has precision ta; a[i,2]|a[i,1] has mean0.5*a[i,1] and precision ta/0.75=4*ta/3. Thus both marginal genetic variances are1/ta and covariance0.5/ta.

Two distinct theta nodes per family remain. Their mean is mu+a[i,t]+c[i], with precision exp(-beta0-beta1*a[i,t]); item logits are theta[i,t]-b[k]. The genetic effect, rather than the total family effect, moderates residual variance. This is the direct-centered target previously independently proved equivalent.

Node definitions form an acyclic hierarchy despite source-code textual ordering: globals -> c/a -> theta -> responses. MZ deterministic nodes have no conflicting stochastic declaration. Global starts are finite and both precisions positive. No invalid deterministic a2 initial values are supplied.

Prepared global starts and seeds830101..830104 are retained. Latent starts are left to JAGS auto-initialization in the new parameterization, not explicitly mapped old latent draws. This is valid as a new experiment but does not preserve initialization trajectories or RNG consumption. Runtime compilation and actual initialized latent finiteness are still checked only during the bounded execution.

Eleven original monitors plus derived log_va,log_vc,log_ve give the same14 quantities. Family1 is MZ by asserted ordering, and a/c monitors retain scientific coordinates. No source F/C alias confusion.
